content_of_post_to_comment: People with Ph.D.s generally agree with the sentiment below. Government is for the experts, they say. Not for the people. I mean, they say that to each other. Not to the people. They say fancy things to please the people while plotting to rule over them.
comment: The deeper tension may be less experts versus people and more how to preserve expertise without turning it into unaccountable authority. A democracy needs knowledge, but also mechanisms to challenge those who claim to possess it.
